# AI interfaces (1)

Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @ballmac/<name>`. Import: `@/components/ballmac/<name>`. Names in parentheses are the exports.

- **agent-roster** (AgentRoster): Every agent on a team of agents as a card: name and role, a status in words (working, waiting, blocked, idle, offline), what it is doing, a load meter and when it was… Not for: One agent's steps; use trace.
